records.title: Exploring Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Techniques for Code Generation with Large Language Models
records.reason: The paper compares LoRA, IA3, prompt/prefix tuning, and QLoRA for code-generation fine-tuning under limited resources. Its efficiency claims concern parameter-efficient training, not lower inference cost or serving.

records.title: CAPO: Critic-Guided Action-Aligned Policy Optimization for Advancing LLM Agent Capabilities
records.reason: CAPO is a critic-guided policy optimization method for LLM agent training; the abstract concerns policy capability/training, not lower inference cost.

records.title: IG-Search: Step-Level Information Gain Rewards for Search-Augmented Reasoning
records.reason: IG-Search uses information-gain rewards to train search-augmented reasoning; its primary abstract explicitly says inference latency is unchanged and discusses only training overhead, so it is out of the inference-efficiency scope.

records.title: Efficient RL Training for LLMs with Experience Replay
records.reason: The paper explicitly investigates experience replay for efficient LLM RL training; training efficiency is outside the target.

records.title: Goedel-Code-Prover: Hierarchical Proof Search for Open State-of-the-Art Code Verification
records.reason: Goedel-Code-Prover improves code verification through hierarchical proof search; the abstract proposes reasoning/search capability, not a reduction in inference resources.
